walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA A-Level Religious Studies specification.

Themes in the Synoptic Gospels appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Themes in the Synoptic Gospels in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Themes in the Synoptic Gospels.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
